title: s0f focus-fit effective-focal calibration
description:
New focus-fit subcommand in image_stab_measure: turns the gyro
cross-check's persistent x-slope finding (1.216-1.22 on the real
hand-held clips) into a measured effective focal - the S10 input and
the missing piece of the gyrocheck translation acceptance.

Method (core/tests/image_stab_focus_fit.hpp, pure layer shared with
the doctest suite; production code untouched, no constants written):
the translation part of a pure-rotation homography is LINEAR in the
focal, so one prediction pass per sync-offset candidate at the
container focal gives every focal-scale candidate by multiplication,
and the best scale against the measured pairs is the closed-form
least-squares k* = (pred.meas)/(pred.meas self-dot) - no grid search
over k. The (offset, k) joint optimization the brief asked for
becomes: scan offset +-150 ms at 5 ms, solve k at each candidate,
